about: Each skill's wick for the one build (docs/design/ONE_BUILD.md 4): twelve lamps in three strands of four, the fourth a Turn, and Unions shared by two skills. The warden's seven skills are written in full. The game does not read this file yet: the build lead wires it (ONE_BUILD 5) and it replaces wicks.json, the evolutions and catalysts in skills.json and the unions' merge. effects: {do: turn} is a built Turn (its wicks.json keys, Sim/Turns.cs); {do: evolve} a built evolution's behavior (tags, art, set, triggers) with skipMods the multipliers the one build retires, because rank carries a skill's power and the card shows it; {do: rule} a named rule (the v1 lamps.json rule ids where they exist, new ids prefixed with the skill); {do: set} built Turn keys (school, status) applied alone. engine: built (the sim does it today), rule (a named rule exists), new (to build). supersedes: lead-ins whose effect the Turn takes over (they keep their rank). draft: the name waits for the story writer. Numbers are first numbers, not tuned: the harness (ONE_BUILD 6) measures them. Checked by tools/classes/skill_lamps_check.py.

rules.run: The ember burns only in a run (table nights, maps, story nights, the prologue's Ford); her build is whole everywhere and every lamp works in full.
rules.opens: Each skill opens at a level per type (skills[].opens): her type's signatures at 1-3, the other type's at 4-6; she carries any open skill her calling may carry, swapped at a lamp-post in town.

costs.unionFrom: 1 from each of its two skills

rank.is: the points burning on the skill's wick, oil and ember together (a Union's point counts on each of its skills)
rank.eachRank: the skill's growth: that share of its base damage
rank.growthSource: skills.json growth; absent (oathblade) it is Weapons.DamageStep, 0.2
rank.card: rank r -> r + 1 (a Turn r -> r + 2)

turnRule.secondNeeds: a Turn on the same skill lit with oil

respec.lightMyWay: spends unplanned points on the suggested strand

candidates: for every carried skill, the first dark lamp of each strand whose parent burns
a Turn only if the Turn rule allows it
every Union whose two skills each burn a Turn
alwaysDealt: a Turn whose three lead-ins burn
offer.alwaysDealtOrder: if more are ready than there are cards, those on the skill that has dealt the most damage tonight first
offer.continuesStrand: a lamp that continues a strand already burning (oil or ember)
offer.justShown: a card in the offer just before (a reroll looks again)

spread.while: two or more skills have candidates

never: a lamp whose parent is dark
a Turn the Turn rule forbids
offer.card: the lamp's name, the skill's glyph, its strand's pips (which lamp of four), the one line, and the rank change; a Turn's card is drawn larger; a Union's shows both glyphs

cards.name: Hotter
cards.rule: One skill burns 1 rank hotter until first light, 10 at most a night.

cards.name: Banked
cards.rule: A third of a Flare, banked at once.

rules.firstLight: puts out every lamp the ember lit and the ranks they brought; oil lamps stay (ONE_BUILD 3)

lamps.name: Crescent
lamps.rule: Every third swing throws a crescent of light 6 m ahead.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.oathblade.morning_edge (a crescent every swing; now every third, and the Turn gives every swing)

lamps.name: Blessed Steel
lamps.rule: Oathblade turns holy: its cuts and crescents sear what they strike for 1 s.
lamps.from: the built Holy Turn's school swap (wicks.json turns.holy), without its 10%

lamps.name: Onward
lamps.rule: A crescent that kills throws another on from where it fell, at 50%, once a swing.

lamps.name: Oathkeeper
lamps.rule: Every swing throws a 2 m crescent of holy light that runs on through the whole crowd.
lamps.from: evolution oathkeeper (catalyst ironhide goes; its mods damage 1.12, cooldown 0.85, area 1.2 retire: rank carries the power)

lamps.name: Notched
lamps.rule: Oathblade's cuts bleed for 35% of the blow over 3 s.
lamps.from: Grave-Edge's bleed, lit first (the evolution's set.status)

lamps.name: Open Wound
lamps.rule: A cut on a bleeding thing starts its bleed over, 50% deeper.

lamps.name: Let Blood
lamps.rule: Oathblade strikes 25% softer, but each cut bleeds for 80% of the blow.

lamps.name: Grave-Edge
lamps.rule: The edge drinks: anything bleeding below a sixth (17%) of its life dies at the next cut.
lamps.from: evolution graveedge (catalyst serration goes; its mods damage 1.91, cooldown 0.9 retire)

lamps.name: On Guard
lamps.rule: A block or a perfect dash swings Oathblade at once, at most every 0.5 s.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.oathblade.shield_and_edge (blocks only; the perfect dash lets every calling answer)

lamps.name: Blow for Blow
lamps.rule: A blow that reaches you swings Oathblade at once too, at most every 1 s.

lamps.name: Slow to Draw
lamps.rule: Oathblade's own swings come 25% slower, but each answer strikes 50% harder.

lamps.name: The Answer
lamps.rule: Oathblade answers every block, perfect dash and blow on you, as often as every 0.3 s; its own swings come half as often.
lamps.from: new (the lead's plan: a trigger Turn)

lamps.name: Found Wanting
lamps.rule: Each thing the disc kills gives it one more ricochet, 5 more at most a throw.

lamps.name: Kept Aloft
lamps.rule: A ricochet off a champion keeps the disc flying 0.5 s longer.

lamps.name: Weighed
lamps.rule: Each ricochet seeks the strongest thing within 6 m, not the nearest.

lamps.name: Reckoning
lamps.rule: The disc ricochets for as long as it flies, each strike 8% heavier than the last.
lamps.from: evolution reckoning (catalysts fortune, precision go; its bounces +6 and damage 1.28 become what its words promised: endless ricochets that grow heavier)

lamps.name: First Ward
lamps.rule: The disc's first strike each throw gives you a barrier of 1% of health.

lamps.name: Arrowbreaker
lamps.rule: The disc flies 25% slower, but it breaks every missile it passes through.

lamps.name: Close Behind
lamps.rule: While a barrier holds, each throw sends a second disc after the first, at 50%.

lamps.name: Aegis Wheel
lamps.rule: Two discs fly each throw, and every ricochet gives you a barrier of 1% of health, 20% held at most.
lamps.from: evolution aegis_wheel (catalysts ironhide, vitality go; damage 1.72 retires; the second disc and the barrier stay)

lamps.name: Last Word
lamps.rule: The disc's last ricochet bursts into 3 shards that fly on 5 m, each at 40%.

lamps.name: Cloven
lamps.rule: A heavy throw splits in two, each at 75% (a stalker: a throw within 1 s of a dash).

lamps.name: Splinters
lamps.rule: The disc flies 25% slower, but its shards ricochet twice each.

lamps.name: Threefold
lamps.rule: Three smaller discs fly each throw, each at 28% damage and 75% size.

lamps.name: Kind Light
lamps.rule: A pulse that strikes 5 or more mends you 1% of health.

lamps.name: Sun in Their Eyes
lamps.rule: Dawnpulse strikes 20% softer, but what it sears strikes you 15% weaker.

lamps.name: Mantle
lamps.rule: For 2 s after each pulse, whatever strikes you is seared.

lamps.name: Circle of Dawn
lamps.rule: Each pulse mends you 4 health for every thing it strikes.
lamps.from: evolution circle_of_dawn (catalysts vitality, recovery go; damage 2.05, area 1.2 retire; set.heal 4 stays)

lamps.name: Standing Ring
lamps.rule: The ring stands 1 s at its full width, burning what crosses it at 30% a second.

lamps.name: Sunstruck
lamps.rule: A pulse that strikes a champion leaves daylight 2 m round under it, burning 3 s at 30% a second.

lamps.name: Burnt Offering
lamps.rule: Dawnpulse comes 25% slower, but what dies in its daylight bursts 2 m round at 50% of the pulse.

lamps.name: Sunbreak
lamps.rule: Each pulse leaves a ring of daylight 3.5 m round that burns 2.5 s, at 30% of the pulse a second.
lamps.from: evolution sunbreak (catalyst might goes; damage 2.26 retires; set.groundOnHit stays)

lamps.name: Dawn Rhythm
lamps.rule: A heavy blow fires Dawnpulse as well, at most every 1.5 s (an arcanist: a kill by another spell).
lamps.from: v1 sunderer.dawnpulse.dawn_rhythm (it replaced the timer; now it adds to it, so a first lamp never costs pulses)

lamps.name: Where the Blow Falls
lamps.rule: A pulse fired by a heavy blow rises 3.75 m round where the blow landed, not about you (an arcanist: where the thing died).

lamps.name: Keep Time
lamps.rule: Dawnpulse's own timer runs 50% longer, but a heavy blow (an arcanist: a spell kill) may fire it every 0.8 s.

lamps.name: Dawn upon Dawn
lamps.rule: Each pulse goes off three times, 0.3 s apart, each at 70% damage and 85% size.

lamps.name: Third Blow
lamps.rule: Every 3rd swing is heavy, not every 4th.

lamps.name: Harvest
lamps.rule: A heavy blow that kills 3 or more makes the next swing heavy too.

lamps.name: Thrown Down
lamps.rule: Sunder swings 10% slower, but what a heavy blow throws back knocks down what it lands on, stunned 0.5 s.

lamps.name: Splitting Stroke
lamps.rule: Every second swing is heavy and splits the ground; Sunder swings 15% slower.

lamps.name: Wide Swing
lamps.rule: Sunder sweeps 300°, not 220°, and what it strikes at your back is thrown round in front of you.
lamps.from: v1 sunderer.sunder.wide_swing (the 300° is built; the throw round in front is new, so it is a shape and not more area)

lamps.name: Two Furrows
lamps.rule: The heavy line forks at 4 m into two, 30° apart, each running 4 m on.

lamps.name: Plowshare
lamps.rule: Sunder swings 10% slower, but its heavy line throws what it strikes aside, opening a lane 2 m wide.

lamps.name: Three Furrows
lamps.rule: The heavy line splits in three, 25° apart, each running its full 7 m.

lamps.name: Burning Edge
lamps.rule: Sunder's heavy line sears what it strikes for 3 s.

lamps.name: Hot Iron
lamps.rule: Sunder strikes 15% softer, but every swing sears, not only the heavy line.

lamps.name: Tinder
lamps.rule: A heavy blow on a seared thing sets it burning 3 s, at 25% of the blow a second.

lamps.name: Watch-Fire
lamps.rule: Sunder takes holy fire: it becomes holy, strikes 10% harder, and everything it sears burns 3 s at 25% a second.
lamps.from: built Turn holy (wicks.json) plus a burn on all it sears (new)

lamps.name: Sinking Ground
lamps.rule: Before the heave strikes, everything within 4 m slides 1.5 m toward its heart.

lamps.name: Full Weight
lamps.rule: Every heave is heavy, not every 6th.
lamps.from: new (the warden's Hand makes every 6th firing heavy: hands.json warden.every)

lamps.name: Driven Deep
lamps.rule: Groundbreaker comes 1 s slower, but the heave's heart, 1 m round, strikes twice as hard.

lamps.name: Second Heave
lamps.rule: 0.8 s later the heave strikes the same spot again at 35%, stunning again.
lamps.from: built Turn groundbreaker.aftershock, renamed: Aftershock is a board link (lamps_v2.json)

lamps.name: Twin Cracks
lamps.rule: Groundbreaker opens two cracks, 30° apart, each to its own pack.

lamps.name: Fault Line
lamps.rule: The cracks run 14 m and stay open 2 s; what walks across one is slowed 40% for 1 s.
lamps.from: v1 sunderer.groundbreaker.fault_line (14 m is built; alone it was bare reach, so the open crack is added)

lamps.name: Thickest Press
lamps.rule: The cracks seek the thickest packs within 14 m, not the nearest.

lamps.name: Crow's Foot
lamps.rule: Groundbreaker opens three cracks, 30° apart, each to its own pack and its own heave.
lamps.from: new (the lead's plan: three cracks; extends the twin rule)

lamps.name: Upheaval
lamps.rule: Lesser things the heave strikes are thrown up 0.8 s, and take 30% more while in the air.

lamps.name: Down They Come
lamps.rule: What falls from the air lands hard, striking 1.5 m round at 30% of the heave.

lamps.name: Great and Small
lamps.rule: Groundbreaker comes 20% slower, but champions are thrown up too, for 0.5 s.

lamps.name: Riven Earth
lamps.rule: The whole crack heaves: everything along it is thrown up 1 s, not only the pack at its end.
lamps.from: new (the lead's plan: a new Turn)

lamps.name: Thronged
lamps.rule: A rebuke that strikes 4 or more gives you a barrier of 0.2% of health.

lamps.name: Broken Ward
lamps.rule: When your barrier breaks, Rebuke strikes everything within 5 m at once.

lamps.name: Glare
lamps.rule: While a barrier holds, Rebuke's light sears what it strikes for 3 s.

lamps.name: Shield of Morning
lamps.rule: Each rebuke gives you a barrier of 0.1% of health for each thing it strikes, 0.4% at most.

lamps.name: Rebuke the Strong
lamps.rule: A champion's blow on you is rebuked at once, even inside the 0.5 s.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.rebuke.rebuke_the_strong (twice as hard on champions was a bare bump; now champions are answered at once)

lamps.name: Brought Low
lamps.rule: A champion Rebuke strikes deals you 25% less for 3 s.

lamps.name: Dazed
lamps.rule: Rebuke strikes 3 fewer of the nearest, but a champion it strikes is stunned 0.5 s.

lamps.name: Humbled
lamps.rule: A rebuke on a champion is a heavy blow, and its light breaks out 4 m round the champion.

lamps.name: Answering Light
lamps.rule: Each rebuke mends you 1% of health.

lamps.name: Readier Wall
lamps.rule: Each blow your shield turns lays 1 Stone, so the wall answers sooner.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.rebuke.readier_wall (the wall answered at five Stones, a bare threshold; now turned blows lay Stones)

lamps.name: Salve
lamps.rule: When the wall answers, its light mends you 1% for each thing it strikes, 10% at most.

lamps.name: Grace
lamps.rule: A blow your shield turns mends you as much as it would have struck, 2% of health at most.

lamps.name: Alarm
lamps.rule: When the wall answers, the bell tolls at once and its 6 s starts over.

lamps.name: Millstone
lamps.rule: While you hold 12 or more Stones, what the bell draws lands stunned 0.5 s.

lamps.name: Cairn
lamps.rule: Each toll that draws 5 or more lays a Stone.

lamps.name: Stone Bell
lamps.rule: Each toll lays 2 Stones, and each champion it draws lays 1 more.

lamps.name: Loud Bell
lamps.rule: The bell tolls twice, 1 s apart: the second draws from 11 m and gives no barrier.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.watch_bell.loud_bell (drew from 10 m: bare reach; now a second, farther toll)

lamps.name: Arm's Length
lamps.rule: What the bell draws stops 2 m from you, in a ring, not at your feet.

lamps.name: In Their Wake
lamps.rule: Each champion the bell draws drags the 3 nearest lesser things with it.

lamps.name: Muster
lamps.rule: The bell draws everything within 10 m into a press 3 m before you, all facing you.
lamps.from: new (the lead's plan: the draw's shape)

lamps.name: Iron Bell
lamps.rule: What the bell draws is slowed 30% for 3 s.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.watch_bell.iron_bell (rule id named, not found in the sim)

lamps.name: Bell and Barrier
lamps.rule: Each slowed thing that strikes you gives you a barrier of 0.5% of health, 15% held at most.
lamps.from: v1 bulwark.watch_bell.bell_and_barrier (1.5% a draw was a bare bump; now the slowed pay it)

lamps.name: Leaden
lamps.rule: The bell tolls 1 s slower, but its slow lasts until the next toll.

lamps.name: Long Toll
lamps.rule: For 3 s after each toll, whatever comes within 6 m is drawn in and slowed too.
lamps.from: new (the lead's plan: a new Turn)

unions.needs: a Turn burning on each of its two skills (any one of each list); both skills keep firing
unions.name: Dawn's Judgement
unions.rule: The disc carries the dawn: it sears for 3 s, and wherever it strikes it breaks into light 2.2 m round, at 35% of the strike.
unions.from: union dawns_judgement (the merge into the dawns_judgement weapon and its freed slot go; that weapon's sear and its on-hit burst, the trigger as written in skills.json, become this lamp)

unions.needs: a Turn burning on each of its two skills (any one of each list); both skills keep firing
unions.name: Broken Country
unions.rule: Sunder's heavy line ends in Groundbreaker's heave: the earth rises there at 40%, stunning 0.4 s.

unions.needs: a Turn burning on each of its two skills (any one of each list); both skills keep firing
unions.name: Curfew
unions.rule: Each toll rebukes what it draws: Rebuke's light strikes everything the bell pulls in, once each 6 s toll.
